nodes.name: reader
nodes.instructions: Read every file in docs/. Build an inventory of factual claims that can go stale: file paths, command names, flags, config keys, version numbers, and counts (e.g. "N panes", "M tests"). List each claim with the doc file and line.
nodes.expects: nothing — this is the first node
nodes.produces: an inventory of checkable claims, one per line: docs/<file>:<line> — claim

nodes.name: grep
nodes.instructions: Take the claims inventory and check each one against the tree: grep the source for every path, command, flag, and config key it names. Report each claim as OK or STALE (with what the source actually says). Do not fix anything — just produce the stale-list.
nodes.produces: a stale-list: claims that no longer match the source, with evidence

nodes.name: fixer
nodes.instructions: Read the stale-list. For each STALE entry, draft the minimal doc edit that makes the claim true again — quote the old line and the replacement. Do not touch claims marked OK, do not rephrase for style, and do not invent new facts: if the source is ambiguous, flag it for the user instead of guessing.
nodes.produces: a set of minimal doc edits (old line → new line), or flags for ambiguous claims
